mechanism: For each source domain compute equal-cell mean of complete-parent OOF residual y-parent. Subtract this domain mean from source residual training targets; keep source features unchanged. Never add domain offsets at inference. Offsets stored only for provenance.
selection: Original B123 validation domain-equal MAE chooses feature/learner/alpha/gain shared across8parents. All21fold choices frozen before query scoring. Ties smaller gain then key.
control: Centered constant is numerically zero and is an identity control, not a new bias correction. Matched ordinary residual with same key/gain required, plus independently selected original plain screen.
acceptance: All3dataset MAE/RMSE/P95 independent and incremental improvement;16group complementarity, paired uncertainty and risk stability unchanged
limits: Only source query labels already in original budget are used
No query-domain truth, inference offsets, datasetwise switches or additional labels
Demeaning can discard useful signal and is not proof of invariant or causal representation
Centering targets alone is not joint fixed-effects regression or feature residualization
Existing parent configuration selection inherited; reused development cohorts, not independent confirmation
Standard residual centering is not claimed novel; CALCE excluded; M1-M3 unchanged
